office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Karama H. Hawkins is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge in Shoreline Position 2 who presides over the court's regional mental health and veterans courts, per her pamphlet statement.
highlights: Presides over Regional Mental Health Court and Regional Veterans Court [S1]
Has presided over the Shoreline/Kenmore Community Court program [S1]
Serves on the DMCJA Board of Governors [S1]
